entities.name: Miloš Nikić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miloš Nikić is a Serbian volleyball player (Wing-spiker). He was part of the Serbia and Montenegro men's national volleyball team at the 2006 FIVB Volleyball Men's World Championship in Japan. He was a member of the Serbian national team at the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing and 2012 Summer Olympics in London. He plays for Italian club DHL Modena Volley.
